      Diagnostic close: the committed B13 interface closes on the plain Boca-Fock only if one supplies both the missing completion instance and a full global unitary from the whole plain Fock space to the single-factor Stinespring space K (phi x). The committed head split does not construct such a unitary.

      Full relative head-block equivalence. This is the head block required by the operator-valued Boca construction: the head factor is an interior tensor over End H, not the plain Hilbert tensor used in BocaFock.
